required_before_traffic: Verify both accounts and confirm billing total below authorized budget
Confirm domain ownership and inventory all DNS including email MX/TXT before any change
Build immutable image from clean committed sources, excluding secrets and business documents
Verify a common authoritative PostgreSQL database with TLS and restricted access
Configure shared durable attachments, reports and fiscal XML; local files are not replicated
Provision existing encryption/session secrets securely without logging them
Keep exactly one owner of email/notification and accounting startup jobs
Implement transactional idempotency for financial and service writes before enabling replay
Inventory desktop hardcoded URLs and move them to the approved stable origin
Use health/ready, not root or health/live, for routing probes
Verify readiness failure on pool exhaustion and read-only/unreachable database
Test login, permissions, service creation, billing and report files in isolated staging
Test lost-response scenarios without duplicate services, payments or journal entries
Confirm rollback and test backup restoration before production activation
Set SOM_STANDBY_VALIDATED=true only after all checks and approval
database_limitations: Two APIs using one PostgreSQL server do not protect against its outage. Database promotion requires fencing the old primary and an explicit tested recovery policy.
retry_policy: Do not replay POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE after uncertain outcomes. No automatic client/proxy write retries until transaction-level idempotency is verified.
scheduler_failover: Manual ownership handoff only; a standby never launches background jobs even when accepting API traffic.
